Kernel version enforcement for kprobes/kretprobes was removed from
5.0 kernel in 6c4fc209fcf9 (""bpf: remove useless version check for prog load"").

column2: BPF programs were specifying SEC(""version"") just to please

column1: libbpf. We should stop enforcing this in libbpf

column2: libbpf now will pre-populate current kernel version
in case we are still running on old kernel.

column1: This patch also removes __bpf_object__open_xattr from libbpf.h
nothing in libbpf is relying on having it in that header. That function
was never exported as LIBBPF_API and even name suggests its internal
version. So this should be safe to remove
